question: Under the capacity limit, does weighting each scored position's root-reference KL -- and the structural operators' activation statistics -- by the FROZEN ORIGINAL TEACHER's full-vocabulary confidence select a structural initialization that, after the frozen recovery recipe, recovers more autonomous task correctness than the standing incumbent B?

motivation.title: teacher-certainty-weighted fidelity
motivation.premise: Where the frozen original teacher is certain -- low full-vocabulary entropy -- its next-token distribution encodes a determinate fact, step or format the compressed student should keep. Where it is uncertain, several continuations are acceptable and the KL to its spread-out distribution is a weaker signal of structural damage.
motivation.consequence: Under the same capacity limit, a structure that preserves the teacher's distribution at the teacher's certain positions may keep more of what matters for reasoning than one that minimizes the KL uniformly over every scored position.
motivation.question: Does weighting the root-reference KL, and the structural operators' activation statistics, by the frozen teacher's confidence select an initialization that recovers more autonomous task correctness than the standing incumbent B?
motivation.role_of_confidence: c_T is a property of the frozen teacher at the calibration and evaluation positions. No candidate can change it, so a candidate cannot lower the objective by becoming confident. It is a PROXY for where fidelity matters; its value is decided by behavioural evidence after recovery, never assumed

hypothesis: Positions at which the frozen teacher is certain carry the information a small student most needs to preserve; spending the structural selection's fidelity budget there, rather than uniformly, selects initializations that recover more autonomous task correctness. This does NOT assume the teacher's uncertain positions are unimportant -- it tests whether down-weighting their KL, and their weight in the activation statistics, helps or hurts.

objective.formula: L_D2(x) = (1/T_x) sum_{t in T_x} c_T(t) KL(p_T || q_C)_t, minimized; c_T(t) = 1 - H_T(t)/log|V|, H_T the frozen original teacher's full-vocabulary Shannon entropy (float32, chunked), KL on the Top-200 + tail support against the ROOT for every consumer
fixed: no dynamic weight sum in the KL objective
no threshold, exponent or hard mask on c_T

acts_directly_on: DEPTH operator-local candidate evaluation: c_T-weighted root KL

FFN, residual WIDTH and ATTENTION activation statistics: every accumulator -- residual sum and second moment, FFN sum|a| and sum a^2, per-head attention-output second moment -- weighted by c_T, over a sum-of-weights denominator
global state evaluation of every child (reference: the teacher)

denominators.kl_objective: the fixed 1/T_x over the item's scored positions; never the sum of weights
denominators.activation_statistics: sum_t w_t, with w_t = policy token weight x c_T(t); a zero-weight position is dropped like padding

scope.token_alignment: token j carries c_T of prediction j -- the logits its own state produces -- and the item's last token, which feeds no prediction inside the item, carries zero; the supervised-target policy's token weights are its prediction weights with that same trailing zero
not_weighted: the scored-position set, which stays the binary supervised-target policy
operators outside D1's frozen four (none is in the search space)

narrow_scope_comparison.difference: FFN, WIDTH and ATTENTION keep D1's target-aware statistics; their configs then declare no objective and their selections are D1's for the same parent
narrow_scope_comparison.status: DOCUMENTED FOR COMPARISON ONLY; not wired, not frozen

full_scope_review.implemented: aadistill core: ActivePositions token multipliers, the collectors' token_weights path (process / process_batch, per-item and packed), the weighted denominators residual_weight / attn_token_weight, and a statistics cache key that carries the weighting store's identity so weighted and unweighted passes never share an entry
risks: LOW DYNAMIC RANGE: normalised by log|V| (~11.9 nats at a 151,936 vocabulary), c_T sits near 1 wherever the teacher's entropy is a few nats, so the weighting may change the statistics and the ranking only modestly. Measured by the teacher-confidence validity check BEFORE the search; never re-defined post hoc
WIDTH's projection is trace-normalised per collection point, so a near-uniform weighting cancels; the weighting acts through its non-uniformity only
teacher-UNCERTAIN positions -- branch points in a reasoning chain -- lose weight in the structure selection as well as in the KL; whether that helps is the hypothesis, not an assumption
the reduced effective sample size of the weighted statistics (reported as ESS by the validity check)
full_scope_review.blockers: none found; the full scope is frozen

where_it_applies.depth.causal_kl_greedy_v1: OPERATOR-LOCAL: the candidate is the parent with S bypassed; its KL against the ROOT's stored sketch, weighted by the root's stored confidence
where_it_applies.ffn / residual_width / attention activat: FULL SCOPE: their activation statistics are weighted by the frozen teacher's confidence, which needs no candidate; their configs declare the objective and their state ids fork from D1's
where_it_applies.state evaluation: every child, against the original teacher, weighted by the teacher's own confidence

aggregation_control.issue: revision 2 averaged state-evaluation items EQUALLY, where D1's KL-only state metrics weight items by scored positions within a sub-type and pool critical classes over items. That changed length weighting as well as the integrand, so a D1-vs-D2 ranking change could not be attributed to confidence
aggregation_control.resolution: each consumer keeps its KL-only path's weighting (objective identity field `aggregation`, kl_path_weighting_per_consumer/v2): DEPTH averages items equally, as D1's DEPTH did; state evaluation weights items by T_x and pools critical classes. The per-item formula keeps the fixed 1/T_x and never divides by a sum of confidence weights
aggregation_control.built_in_kl_only_control: every objective evaluation also reports state.objective.raw_kl.* -- the raw KL aggregated exactly as the objective is -- which equals D1's state.teacher_kl.* and state.critical_token_kl in the same evaluation (tested to 1e-6). Rankings by raw_kl and by the objective on the same states isolate the effect of the integrand

teacher_confidence_validity.checks: stages.d_series.teacher_confidence: distribution, thinking vs answer, domain and subtype, token types, relation to teacher token probability and to KL, weighted contributions, weight sum, mean, ESS and risks -- run on the root reference store before the formal search; their results never change a definition

beam._why_unchanged: the standing declared schedule. D1/D2/D3 share a beam width so the BREADTH is not a variable between them, and adopting a different one here would be a new breadth decision taken for no measured reason.

root_reference.what: one store per calibration profile, built once from the frozen teacher: Top-200 + tail sketch, full-vocabulary entropy and confidence, target log-probability and top-1 (diagnostics)
root_reference.identity: root teacher id + sha256, profile hash, support, entropy definition, confidence mapping and row set; a declaration, not a tensor hash -- the content digest is evidence

search.measurer: StateEvaluator with the SAME scoring objective (teacher full-vocabulary entropy computed once per item); BeamSearch refuses any mismatch

execution.prediction_rows: all_v1, unless the D2 GPU validation's scored_v1 equivalence for THIS objective passes under R0's tolerances before the search authorization, then scored_v1. R0 (KL path) and stage L (the superseded objective) do not establish it for this objective. An execution choice, recorded in the run's execution fingerprint; it changes no estimand

retention.rule: Diversity is used only during search-time beam pruning. Final post-search Top-K must NOT use lineage diversity.
retention.post_search: epsilon-Pareto quality order + deterministic tie-break -> NO lineage diversity
retention.order: OBJECTIVE_PARETO_V1 quality order over complete leaves, deterministic tie-break; no lineage diversity

search_diagnostics.kl_only_control: every state carries state.objective.raw_kl.* (the unweighted teacher KL, equal to D1's state.teacher_kl.*) beside the objective; the D1 ranking of D2's complete leaves under PARETO_V1 on those raw-KL metrics is reported, never used
search_diagnostics.per_candidate: DEPTH records the weighted objective, the unweighted root KL, reference entropy, reference confidence, the weight, reference tail mass and joint histograms for every candidate subset, and the PARENT-reference KL for every round-0 candidate
search_diagnostics.parent_kl_scope: round 0 of every DEPTH expansion only: one parent reference pass per expansion and one extra reduction per round-0 candidate. Enough to set the D1-style parent ranking of the first removal beside the root one; the later rounds are not covered, by design
search_diagnostics.root_reference_evidence: each store's identity, content digest, build seconds and confidence distribution (weight sum, mean, ESS) in the search record and the telemetry
search_diagnostics.flags: diagnostic_threshold_rule, thresholds from the reference calibration frozen BEFORE this search; computed offline; never a selection rule
search_diagnostics.no_third_kl_only_search: the KL-only comparison is the built-in control on D2's own states and D1's completed search -- not a new search

screening.comparator: B's two imported screening units -- not retrained, not regenerated

rule.statistic: pooled seed-mean correct_overall delta vs B, C0's guardrail vetoes
rule.selection: exactly one candidate advances, or none
rule.tie_break: the experiment's frozen quality position, then state id
rule.field: frozen by the experiment's own retention decision before any behavioural datum; its size is that experiment's preregistered choice
rule.q2_screening_rows: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY. q2 advanced on these prompts and seeds, so its screening estimate is inflated by the winner's curse (screening +0.00825 vs B, confirmation -0.000392). Never a ranking comparator

confirmation.candidate: exactly the one screening advances, or none
confirmation.secondary: q2's three imported units, descriptive only

outcomes.SHARED_GO: one-sided (1 - per_experiment_alpha) LCB > 0 AND delta >= SESOI AND >= 2 of 3 seed deltas > 0 AND no guardrail veto. NOT a promotion: it nominates the candidate for a fresh independent confirmation on its reserved battery
outcomes.NO_GO: one-sided (1 - per_experiment_alpha) UCB < SESOI, or a guardrail veto. Terminal for that candidate
outcomes.INCONCLUSIVE: otherwise. Terminal; never rerun on these rows

instruments.rollout_profile: scripts/stages/stage-1/families/d_series/rollout_profile.py -- text-level, $0, from secured generations: generated length (engine count), reasoning/answer length, natural termination, degeneration, correctness by reasoning length, and paired same-prompt comparisons
instruments.rollout_rescoring: scripts/shared/evaluation/rollout_rescoring.py -- per position of the student's own rollout: student confidence, student token log-prob, teacher surprisal, KL(teacher || student). Needs the trained checkpoint, so it runs ON THE POD after generation and before the checkpoint is released. Reads generations; changes neither generation nor scoring, so the shared evaluation protocol's identity is untouched. Estimated 3-5 GPU-minutes per probe (~0.95M tokens per probe at D1's measured lengths)

analyses.question: does the student still solve the task when it is far from the teacher's distribution?

analyses.question: how does student confidence relate to actual correctness?

analyses.question: are high-confidence, high-KL positions valid alternative reasoning or wrong overconfidence?

analyses.question: did D2/D3 improve autonomous generation after recovery, not only the search objective?

analyses.arms: candidates vs the imported B/q2 units

diagnostics.historical_units: B's and q2's ten units have decoded text and the engine's token counts, but NO token ids, log-probabilities or logits, and their checkpoints are retired. Their student confidence on their own rollouts is therefore NOT available and must not be estimated or inferred; comparisons with B/q2 are text-level and endpoint-level only. Re-tokenizing their text reproduces the engine's count exactly for 82-85% of samples
diagnostics.power_note: D1's units answer ~2-4% of scorable prompts correctly (B: 103 of 2550 on confirmation), and q2 and B are both right on only 29 prompt-seeds there. Any confidence-correctness or quadrant analysis rests on ~100 correct samples per arm and is exploratory

rescoring_integration.token_ids: use the generation engine's exact ids, kept by the read-only sidecar wrapper scripts/shared/evaluation/uncapped_eval_token_ids.py. It runs the UNCHANGED in-tree generator (same argv, interpreter and environment) with a hook on the one post-wave decode per record, after the engine loop, so the generation source set, the generation fingerprint and the shared protocol's evaluation identity are the plain run's -- tested on the real generator with a stub engine: identical records, summaries and reconstructed fingerprint. The hook installs only when the generator's source digest equals the protocol's; every row is verified against its record (id count, prompt count, decoded-text sha256, EOS vs stop_reason) and the sidecar header says whether the stratum is exact. A record with no exact row is rescored from retokenized text, ids_source=retokenized_text, labelled approximate per sample. Recording ids inside the generator itself remains a VERSIONED decision (d_series_shared_eval v2), not taken

token_ids_identity.changes: only the behavioural driver's own executable closure, because its argv names the wrapper -- correct for reproducibility, and not part of the generation identity
token_ids_identity.not_in_generation_source_set: the wrapper is deliberately NOT added to source_sets.json generation.files: adding it would move the source digest it exists to preserve
token_ids_identity.residual: engine scheduling is timing-dependent in the plain run too; the wrapper adds no work inside the engine loop, so it changes no code path the tokens depend on, but token equality with a counterfactual plain run cannot be proven on a non-batch-invariant engine

alignment_evidence: count and decoded-text match with the record
untouched: the shared protocol's scoring contract and endpoint
rescoring_integration.checkpoint_release: only after the diagnostic evidence is persisted durably, when a consumer exists
rescoring_integration.failure_isolation: a rescoring failure is recorded per sample and never alters or blocks a completed per-sample score (rollout_rescoring.rescore_unit)
rescoring_integration.cost: MEASURE before pricing: the reference calibration session times the rescoring on the real teacher and B over sequences of D1's measured lengths; the behavioural ceiling includes it only after that measurement. The 3-5 min/probe figure is an estimate, not a bound
rescoring_integration.historical_units: no logits, confidence or student-side quantity is computed or estimated for B or q2

shared_with_d3.goal: structural initializations that, under the capacity limit, help the student keep and recover its own effective reasoning
may_claim: a D2/D3 candidate's endpoint result against B on the shared protocol, with that protocol's limits (SHARED_GO nominates, never promotes)
descriptive rollout and rescoring diagnostics of the candidates that were actually measured, labelled exploratory
may_not_claim: that a lower D2/D3 search objective means better reasoning or higher fidelity
any confidence or per-position statement about B or q2, whose checkpoints are retired and whose generations carry no log-probabilities
a mechanism from the exploratory diagnostics alone

that the family-wise bound across D1-D3 is an unconditional guarantee: it is a nominal accounting bound, conditional on each test's nominal level, which adaptive reuse of the observed confirmation data can violate
shared_with_d3.validation: each objective's confidence signal is a proxy for structure selection; its usefulness is established only by independent behavioural evidence after recovery training

may_not_claim: that D2 differs from D1 by one variable: it declares two changes, the DEPTH reference (parent -> root) and the teacher-confidence weighting (d2.declared_changes)
that a lower D2 objective means the student is closer to the teacher: it down-weights the teacher's uncertain positions by construction
that the teacher's confident positions are the ones that matter for reasoning, without behavioural evidence after recovery
that the full-scope weighting changed an FFN, WIDTH or ATTENTION selection, unless a measured selection overlap shows it
that D2 reads any student confidence: its weight is the frozen teacher's and no candidate can move it
